settings.artDirection: Original low-poly city actors in the approved daylight palette. Rounded anonymous pedestrians with jackets and trousers; a stylized burgundy and ivory twin-cab tram with dark glazing and a pantograph. No claim to a specific real vehicle series.
settings.provenance: Original procedural models. Paths constrained by the local OSM snapshot and validated against the prototype collider. Crowd placement and tram shuttle timing are artistic simulation, not live traffic or a real timetable.
